title: All Beings Praise You Daily
program_note:
This étude for organ is based on material composed for a choir setting of various different Psalms.  It should give the impression of a continual, measured cascade or flow of music down from above, together with a joyous upwelling from below.

The music is approximately 4:00 in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz

9 June, 2005

Los Angeles, CA
